name: list_shipments
description: List all shipments with their current status, origin, destination, carrier and estimated arrival date. Use this for broad questions about shipments or deliveries in transit.

status.description: Optional status filter, for example 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELAYED' or 'DELIVERED'.

name: get_shipment
description: Retrieve a single shipment by its shipment identifier, including the route it is travelling on.

name: get_route
description: Retrieve a shipping route by its route identifier, including transit days, distance and transport mode.
